results.title: Guangxi real-property “query by map” service
results.note: Offers cadastral map/property information lookup after identity verification, including search by parcel location; no bulk open vector endpoint.

assessment: Guangxi’s official identity-authenticated property map service is a city-relevant lookup lead, but public parcel geometry download/API and exact-ID bulk query remain unverified.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
